answer.question: What is law firm SEO?
answer.text: Law firm SEO is the process of improving a legal practice's visibility in search engines so potential clients find it when they need legal help. It includes local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization, practice area pages, trustworthy legal content, reviews and technical website improvements.

why.title: Why is SEO for lawyers so competitive?

cards.title: High-value, high-competition searches
cards.text: Legal searches are among the most competitive and expensive in paid advertising, which makes organic visibility especially valuable.

cards.title: Local results decide most cases
cards.text: Most clients search for a lawyer nearby, so ranking in the Google Maps "local pack" is critical.

cards.title: Higher content standards
cards.text: Legal content affects people's lives and money, so Google holds it to a higher standard of expertise and trust (E-E-A-T).

cards.title: Advertising rules
cards.text: Law firm marketing must follow professional conduct and advertising rules, which vary by jurisdiction.

cards.title: Practice area pages
cards.text: A dedicated, detailed page for each legal service.

cards.title: Location pages
cards.text: For the cities and areas you serve.

cards.title: Attorney profiles
cards.text: Credentials, experience and bar admissions that build trust.

cards.title: Legal content
cards.text: Plain-English answers to clients' common questions, reviewed by your attorneys.

cards.title: Review strategy
cards.text: Ethical, compliant ways to earn more client reviews.

cards.title: Technical SEO
cards.text: Speed, mobile experience, structured data (LegalService, Attorney).

ai.title: How do AI tools answer legal questions?
ai.text: People now ask AI tools things like "Do I need a lawyer for a car accident?" or "Best family lawyer near me." AI answers draw on trusted legal content, reviews, directories and local business information.
prompts: Do I need a lawyer for a car accident?
ai.list_title: How we improve your AI visibility:
items: Clear, accurate answers to common legal questions on your site
Consistent firm details across Google, Avvo, Justia, Martindale and your bar profile
Strong attorney bios that show real expertise
Monitoring how AI tools describe your firm and practice areas

callout.title: A note on compliance
callout.text: We don't guarantee case outcomes, and we avoid claims like "specialist" or "expert" unless your jurisdiction permits them. All content should be reviewed by an attorney at your firm before publishing.

items.question: How long does SEO take for a law firm?
items.answer: Local SEO improvements can show results within 1–3 months. Competitive practice areas in large cities often take 6–12 months to rank strongly.

items.question: Is SEO better than paid ads for lawyers?
items.answer: They work best together. Ads bring immediate visibility, while SEO builds long-term visibility that doesn't stop when your ad budget does.

items.question: Do I need a separate page for each practice area?
items.answer: Yes. Each practice area, such as personal injury, divorce or estate planning, should have its own detailed page so it can rank for its own searches.

items.question: Can you help with multiple office locations?
items.answer: Yes. We optimize a Google Business Profile and a location page for each real office.

items.question: Is your SEO compliant with legal advertising rules?
items.answer: We follow general best practices and avoid misleading claims, but rules vary by jurisdiction. Your firm should review content against your local bar's advertising rules.
